text: Men waɗi hakkunde yimɓe Saba'i ɓen Yaman e koɗooli Saami ɗin ɗi Men barkini, koɗooli ɓaɗondirɗi. Men eɓɓiri ton yaadu ndun, ka tawata ɓe yaaray hoɗo naɓi hoɗo, ko aldaa e tammpere, haa ɓe hewtoya Saami. Men wi'ani ɓe: Yaaree ton no faaliraɗon, jemma e ñalorma, hara ko o hoolniiɓe daɗugol ayɓe e heege e ɗonka.
